fact: ADN describes itself as a key actor in developing and operationalising Rayuwa, an AI platform available free on the Play Store, targeting 600,000 Nigerien producers within 2.3 million beneficiaries in West Africa.

HiiL says Illimi, a toll-free AI voice companion using a curated knowledge base developed by Niger's Rural Code Directorate, is in pilot in Dosso and Tillaberi, with 863 callers from May to November 2025.
